overview: The board held its annual meeting to elect officers, approved a developer funding application template, reviewed quarterly finances, and discussed potential roles in developing affordable housing on city-owned land.

items.title: Welcome and Introductions
items.summary: Trustees welcomed new board member Megan Kelly and conducted brief round-robin introductions.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the minutes from the September 2 board meeting and the September 9 fundraising working group meeting.

items.title: Annual Meeting: Officer Elections and Working Groups
items.summary: Reelected Lisa Davidson as chair, Penelope Taylor as vice chair, and Kayla Lessen as treasurer, and appointed Teda DeRosa and Megan Kelly to the fundraising working group.

items.title: Quarterly Financial Report
items.summary: Staff and Treasurer Kayla Lessen presented the third quarter 2026 financial report, showing $576,129.01 in total assets, including $200,000 encumbered for a Medford Community Housing loan.

items.title: Housing Resource Fair Summary
items.summary: Staff reported on the housing resource fair, noting that over 50 attendees and 16 organizations participated.

items.title: Affordable Housing Linkage Fee Nexus Study
items.summary: Staff updated the board that draft ordinance language based on the linkage fee nexus study was sent to the Community Development Board.

items.title: Fractional Payment Ordinance Update
items.summary: Staff confirmed the fractional payment ordinance has taken effect.

items.title: Affordable Housing Incentive Bonus
items.summary: Staff shared that the Community Development Board is reviewing zoning table structures to clean up incentive bonus provisions across rezoned districts.

items.title: Funding Application Template
items.summary: Approved the developer funding application template subject to staff reconciling area median income limits with board policies.

items.title: Presentation to Community Preservation Committee
items.summary: Staff outlined plans to present the trust's fiscal year 2027 funding application to the Community Preservation Committee.

items.title: City-Owned Parcels Discussion
items.summary: The board discussed potential roles and staffing considerations for acquiring or developing city-owned parcels for affordable housing.

items.title: Pipeline Updates and Schedule
items.summary: Staff noted an upcoming funding request for Walkling Court Phase 2, and the board voted to cancel its scheduled December meeting.
